title: Google Earth sighting map of ranch area with creature, lights and witness locations
description: Annotated Google Earth satellite map of the Skinwalker Ranch area near Ballard and Fort Duchesne, Utah. Color-coded legend marks Creature, Lights, Place of Interest, Witness Location, and Ranch Property; labeled points include Bottle Hollow Lake, Pow Wow Grounds, Turn Key Housing, Homestead 1 and 2, West Gate, East Gate, and Gravel Pit. White bearing lines and red circles cluster sighting directions (NNW, NNE, SSE, etc.) with redaction boxes (1843(a)(2)) over names.
